criteria.requirement: Extend CodeBlock with caption option, using the original tag_code language/highlight/number-lines path and wrapping captioned output in an actual code-figure figure whose first child is literal_block and second is inline-parsed caption. Attach name/id to the figure for real references and preserve source/line; HTML5 naturally emits figure/figcaption and code escaping. Caption-free nodes/output remain unchanged. Reject empty captions through directive option validation and preserve Unicode/multiline title text and original lexer error policy; do not replace code contents with raw HTML or a rubric.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
